Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Shalini - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Zoya - 8 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Zoya stand near him.]

Zoya: "What lovely weather!"

[The sun is blazing and Rohan is sweating.]

Rohan: "How beautiful!"

[Flower petals rain down on Rohan.]

Rohan: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rohan is sitting on a chair in the living room. Shalini and Zoya stand near him.]

Zoya: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan stands up.]

Shalini: "Let's see."

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Rohan stands in the kitchen. Shalini and Zoya stand near him.]

Zoya: "Rohan, look over here."

[Rohan makes tea for everyone.]

Rohan (happily): "Yes, of course."

[Rohan chops onions for the curry.]

Rohan: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rohan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Rohan (gently): "Careful!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan eats his breakfast at the table.]

Rohan: "One more time!"

[Rohan takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Rohan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan munches on an apple.]

Shalini: "Rohan, look at this."

[Rohan drinks a glass of water.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan sips hot tea from a cup.]

Rohan: "Yes, of course."

[Rohan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Rohan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
